title: India pitches its 2036 Olympic bid to the IOC this week under the shadow of an IOA election row
dek: The IOC has called divisions in the Indian Olympic Association 'extremely regrettable' days before Ahmedabad's presentation to its Future Host Commission, and the IOA's 5 December election is in dispute.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
An Indian delegation will present Ahmedabad's case to host the 2036 Olympic Games to the International Olympic Committee's Future Host Commission in Switzerland on Thursday, at a time when the IOC has publicly rebuked the Indian Olympic Association over a bitter dispute about its coming election.

In a letter earlier this month, the IOC said it was "very disappointed" that "issues and disputes" had resurfaced in the IOA's election process, calling the situation "extremely regrettable" and saying it was harming the reputation of the Olympic Movement in India, according to reports. The IOA has not responded publicly, and the sports ministry declined to comment.

## The election dispute

The IOA's executive council elections are due on 5 December. Its president, P T Usha, the former sprinter who has led the body since 2022, was at first left out of the contest for a second term amid allegations of fraud in the nomination process; she has alleged a "big fraud" herself. She later entered the race after the Ice Hockey Federation of India nominated her, and that nomination has in turn been challenged before the returning officer, reports said.

The IOA has a recent history of such fights. In 2022 the Delhi High Court and the Supreme Court had to step in over the association's failure to comply with the National Sports Development Code, and its constitution and electoral rules were rewritten under court supervision before Ms Usha was elected unopposed.

Sports writers are divided on how much the row will matter. One said the IOA's "massive governance flaw" had not been addressed and would not be hidden by a polished presentation; another said the IOC's displeasure should not cause panic and was unlikely to hurt the bid deeply, according to reports.

## The bid

India is one of seven countries that have told the IOC they are interested in the 2036 Games, alongside Germany, Hungary, Qatar, South Africa, South Korea and Turkey. The government has backed Ahmedabad as the host city, and the delegation is expected to include Ms Usha, the IOC member Nita Ambani and officials of the Gujarat government. The Future Host Commission holds talks with interested countries before any host is put to a vote of the full IOC; no decision on 2036 is expected for several years.

India has never hosted the Olympics. Its main multi-sport events have been the 1951 and 1982 Asian Games in Delhi and the 2010 Commonwealth Games, also in Delhi. Ahmedabad was confirmed last year as host of the 2030 Commonwealth Games, which the government has presented as a step towards an Olympic bid.

## What happens next

Thursday's session is a closed-door presentation, and the IOC does not usually publish its assessment at this stage. The IOA vote follows on 5 December; any further legal challenge to the nominations could delay it.
